subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled structured editor dependency for Control UI raw config editing, and should the work continue by rebuilding the open candidate or by asking for a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it changes a sensitive config editing surface and adds a sizeable UI dependency, so maintainer direction is needed before another implementation lane runs.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency and UX change until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter approach is chosen.

options.title: Request a short design note
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a maintainer-reviewed comparison of dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and browser proof before code continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after a rebuilt or fresh PR targets current main, preserves reveal-to-edit/save semantics, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the reveal-to-edit raw config behavior and is the best available owner for the product/dependency decision.
